items.title: Marico shares jump 6% as strong Q2 puts growth story in overdrive, sparks bullish calls
items.summary: Marico reported a 31% YoY rise in Q2 FY27 net profit to Rs 550 crore, while revenue grew 12% to Rs 3,897 crore. Improved margins and strong volume growth prompted brokerages Jefferies, Systematix and Dolat Capital to maintain or upgrade Buy ratings and raise target prices, signalling optimism about growth prospects.

items.title: Marico shares spurt 6% on robust Q2 earnings, positive revision in guidance
items.summary: Marico reported a 29.16 per cent rise in consolidated net profit to ₹558 crore in the September quarter of FY27, led by strong volume growth in the domestic market.

items.title: SFC Environmental Technologies shares to list today. Check GMP ahead of market debut
items.summary: SFC Environmental Technologies' Rs 667.53-crore IPO received 9.47 times subscription, led by strong institutional demand. Ahead of its November 3 listing, the issue commanded a 5% grey market premium, indicating expectations of modest listing gains.

items.title: Silver crashes below $60 from $122 and enters oversold zone. What should you do?
items.summary: Silver’s sharp rally has reversed amid expectations of higher US interest rates, rising bond yields and a stronger dollar. HSBC expects limited upside as weaker demand, increasing supply and a narrowing market deficit reduce the chances of the metal returning to $100 soon.

items.title: Can India abolish LTCG tax? SBI Research says Centre has ‘fiscal headroom’ to absorb loss, suggests alternatives
items.summary: SBI Research says India has enough ‘fiscal headroom’ to abolish long-term capital gains tax and absorb loss of potential ₹40,000-50,000 FY28 revenue. Instead, it suggests higher exemptions, lower rates for longer-held investments and a 50% increase in STT.

items.title: ET Wealth Expo 2026| India's next investment mega trend is a $1.5 trillion wealth transfer: Ganesh Mohan
items.summary: Speaking on the sidelines of ET Wealth Expo 2026 in Mumbai, Mohan identified intergenerational wealth transfer as one of the major socio-cultural mega trends unfolding in India. He believes the shift will go beyond the transfer of assets between family members and could trigger a fundamental change in investment preferences, with younger investors potentially moving towards financial assets, equities and more…

items.title: Investcorp eyes exit from Kitchen Treasures at up to ₹1,000 crore valuation
items.summary: Investcorp is exploring a sale of its stake in Kitchen Treasures’ parent at a valuation of ₹800-1,000 crore, as investor interest in India’s packaged food market gathers pace.

items.title: NBCC among 5 stocks showing White Marubozu Pattern
items.summary: The pattern is represented by a long white (or green) candlestick with no upper shadow and little or no lower shadow. It reflects strong upward price movement during the session, with the price moving from the opening level toward the session high by the close. The pattern is commonly studied in technical analysis as an indicator of price momentum.

items.title: India will become the world’s largest economy by end of the century, predicts top economist Jeffrey D Sachs
items.summary: Renowned economist Jeffrey D Sachs said India could become the world’s largest economy by the end of the century, with a population twice that of China. Speaking at the World Symposium on "Ancient Wisdom for Modern Challenges" in Varanasi, he said the world was moving towards a multipolar order where no single country or region would dominate.

items.summary: The cuts will disproportionately impact specific operations across Disney's sprawling empire, which includes its theme parks, television networks, and movie studios, Bloomberg said.

items.title: How policy needs to catch up with India’s upcoming demographic reset
items.summary: Demographic shifts occur slowly, so there is a long runway before India loses its ‘youthful’ profile. But being aware of how the arithmetic is changing is crucial to rework policy priorities.

items.title: India's startup funding slows as global investors turn cautious, capital shifts to US
items.summary: Late-stage and angel funding have fallen sharply from their peaks as tighter investment criteria, competition from US AI companies and regulatory changes reshape India's startup financing landscape.

items.summary: The departure of Gordon Louis Chin comes amid a decline in outstanding payments for its services and equipment to AESC and Agratas building its own manufacturing capabilities.

items.title: HPCL says fire at Visakhapatnam refinery controlled, no damage to units
items.summary: The fire broke out around 10 pm on November 2, prompting the refinery’s Fire and Safety Team to activate emergency response measures

items.title: Govt consults seed, fertiliser firms on easing regulatory hurdles
items.summary: The Indian government is engaging with agricultural companies to address regulatory challenges that affect the sector. Consultations focus on updating the Seeds Act, 1966, to align with modern agricultural technology. Industry representatives have pointed out delays in approvals and licensing processes that hinder market access.

items.title: Manufacturing activity eases in Oct as new order growth drops
items.summary: Manufacturing activity in India experienced a slowdown in October, decreasing from the previous month's growth. Despite this, the sector remained above its long-run average due to stronger international demand. A survey indicated that nearly 18% of manufacturers anticipated increased output over the next year, supported by fresh client inquiries.

items.summary: The Indian government is currently reviewing customs duty concessions applicable to 118 products set to expire.
